summary: V20 CRM backend + frontend smoke test. 15/15 pytest cases PASSED (100%). Verified: (1) /api/appointments year-span range works. (2) POST /api/calls/log with outcome_id=call_no_answer + reschedule_delta_min=30 returns log + new_callback with scheduled_at ~30 min ahead and marks original callback done:true with last_call_outcome_id set; call_ok without reschedule returns new_callback:null. (3) Free Sempre lifecycle: create invite (30gg) → register invitee → subscription trial ~30d → PUT free-forever → status free_forever/days_left:null/is_active:true → GET /api/invites shows invited_user.subscription.status=free_forever → PUT revoke-free-forever {mode:trial,trial_days:15} → status trial ~14-15d → re-set free_forever → revoke mode:expired → status expired/is_active:false → non-owner (sub-user) gets 403 → bogus user_id returns 404 for both endpoints → cleanup deletes invite + test user. (4) Appointment note_attachments: POST with 2 attachments (photo base64 + text) persists, GET returns them, PUT [] clears them, verified via GET. (5) Settings /api/settings returns energy_color + network_color; PUT accepts hex '#FF00AA' and returns it; originals restored after test. (6) settings.call_outcomes contains 6 default outcomes with expected ids (call_ok/call_no_answer/call_recall/call_wrong_number/call_busy/call_not_interested). Frontend smoke (mobile viewport 375x667): login OK, Calendario tab shows Settimana/Mese/Anno with testIDs view-week/view-month/view-year (all FOUND); Mese view renders 31 day cells for Luglio 2026 (testID prefix month-day-); Anno view renders 12 month cells (testID prefix year-month-); Profilo tab (impostazioni.tsx) shows brighter area color palette (bright red/orange/yellow/green/teal/blue/purple/pink swatches) with settings-energy-hex + settings-network-hex text inputs FOUND — typing '#FF00AA' updates the color chip live; appointment/new screen has all 4 media buttons ap-media-camera / ap-media-photo / ap-media-audio / ap-media-file FOUND under 'Allegati (foto, audio, file)' section. inv-free-forever-{user_id} verified via code inspection in invitati.tsx line 200 (only rendered on USED invite when not already free_forever). All backend features fully functional.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native console warning still repeated many times on home load: 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Same warning noted in iteration_9. Non-blocking but should be tracked. Reference: home tab / global root.
Deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — comes from library styles. Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the recurring 'Unexpected text node' warnings on the home tab (~13 per render) — likely a bare {expr && ...} pattern producing empty strings or stray spaces inside <View>.

(Optional) Owner settings.energy_color was set to '#FF00AA' during the frontend smoke test via UI (typed in settings-energy-hex) but was NOT saved (user did not tap 'Salva modifiche'), and backend suite restores its own change. Consider verifying the owner's energy_color is still the original in the DB if any doubt.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~2290 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, calls, invites, chat, bulk).

log_call endpoint: when creating a follow-up callback, area/phone are inherited from original callback but the original's `notify_advance_min` is used ONLY if truthy — falsy 0 would fall back to settings default. Acceptable.
GET /api/callbacks default hides done callbacks (include_done=false). Frontend consumers must pass include_done=true to display historical callbacks. Confirmed in test_v20 line by using the flag.
revoke-free-forever with mode='trial' uses trial_days default=30, but body sends 15 → returns days_left 13-15 due to timezone edge-case rounding. Test tolerates 13-15. Acceptable.
set_free_forever unsets trial_expires_at but leaves invited_by intact — good.

success_rate.frontend: smoke pass — all 10 requested testIDs verified (view-week, view-month, view-year, settings-energy-hex, settings-network-hex, ap-media-camera, ap-media-photo, ap-media-audio, ap-media-file, inv-free-forever-{user_id})
